user.title: Orion Sleep Login
user.description: Choose how you log in to your Orion Sleep account.

email.title: Orion Sleep Login
email.description: Enter your Orion Sleep account email. A verification code will be sent to you.

phone.title: Orion Sleep Login
phone.description: Enter your Orion Sleep account phone number. A verification code will be sent to you. Must be 11 digits, ex: 15552221234.

verify.title: Enter Verification Code
verify.description: A verification code has been sent. Please enter it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Orion Sleep
reauth_confirm.description: Your Orion Sleep session has expired. Press submit to receive a new verification code.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Orion Sleep API
error.invalid_phone: Phone number must include the leading 1 country code and be 11 digits total (e.g. 15551234567).

data.insights_days: Days of sleep insights to fetch

aliases.title: Display Names
aliases.description:
Set the name you want shown for each person: {people}.

This changes friendly names only. Entity IDs, history, dashboards, and voice assistant aliases are unaffected. Leave a field blank to use the name from the Orion account.

partner_method.title: Link Partner Account
partner_method.description: Choose how your partner signs in to Orion Sleep.

partner_email.title: Link Partner Account
partner_email.description: Enter your partner's Orion Sleep email. Orion will send a verification code.

partner_phone.title: Link Partner Account
partner_phone.description: Enter your partner's 11 digit Orion Sleep phone number, including the leading 1.

partner_verify.title: Verify Partner Account
partner_verify.description: Enter the verification code Orion sent to your partner.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Orion Sleep API
error.invalid_phone: Phone number must include the leading 1 country code and be 11 digits total.
error.partner_device_ambiguous: Partner linking requires both accounts to contain exactly one matching Orion bed.

override_schedule.name: Override schedule for today
override_schedule.description: Change one person's schedule for today only, without touching their stored weekday settings. Target the Bedtime or Wake Up Time entity of whoever's schedule should change. Everything given is sent in a single request. Temperatures use the app's -10 to +10 offset scale.

wakeup.name: Wake up time
wakeup.description: Wake up time for tonight only.

bedtime_temp_offset.name: Bedtime temperature offset
bedtime_temp_offset.description: Temperature at bedtime, on the -10 to +10 scale.

phase_1_temp_offset.name: Asleep phase 1 offset
phase_1_temp_offset.description: Temperature during the first asleep phase.

phase_2_temp_offset.name: Asleep phase 2 offset
phase_2_temp_offset.description: Temperature during the second asleep phase.

bedtime_is_active.name: Bedtime enabled
bedtime_is_active.description: Whether the bedtime action runs tonight.

wakeup_is_active.name: Wake up enabled
wakeup_is_active.description: Whether the wake up action runs tomorrow.

auto_turn_off.name: Automatic turn off
auto_turn_off.description: Whether the bed powers down after wake up.

start_cooling.name: Start cooling
start_cooling.description: Start hot flash relief on one side of the bed. Overrides the schedule with maximum cooling, then restores what it was doing.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: How long to keep cooling, in minutes.

stop_cooling.name: Stop cooling
stop_cooling.description: End hot flash relief early on one side of the bed. The device restores the temperature and power state it saved when relief began.

list_sleep_sessions.name: List sleep sessions
list_sleep_sessions.description: List recent sleep sessions for one person, newest first, so a session ID can be found. Read-only. Target any of that person's sleep insight sensors.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many sessions to return. Defaults to 30.

delete_sleep_session.name: Delete sleep session
delete_sleep_session.description: Permanently delete one sleep session. There is no undo. Use List sleep sessions first to find the ID, and target the same person's sensor.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: The session to delete. Get this from List sleep sessions.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Why it is being removed. 'not_real_session' is for a night the bed logged that never happened.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on. Deleting a session cannot be undone.
